disposition_reason: Government retail survey with percent positive, mean of positives and maximum for As, Cd, Pb and Hg in four product types (Table 2).

study.design: CFIA targeted retail survey, 957 samples in 4 product types
study.origin: Domestic 126, imported 725, unspecified 106 (Table 1); balsamic vinegar 17 Canadian, 229 imported, 3 unspecified
study.market: Local and regional retail in 11 Canadian cities (Atlantic, Quebec, Ontario, West)
study.method: ISO/IEC 17025 accredited contract laboratory; method not described
